skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop mobile applications using Android or iOS platforms.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Objective-C, Swift.
Design user interfaces for mobile applications.
Implement data storage solutions for mobile apps.
Understand and implement networking concepts in mobile app development.
Utilize APIs to enhance functionality in mobile applications.
Collaborate effectively in teams to develop mobile applications.
Demonstrate ability to independently learn new technologies and apply them in mobile app development.
